profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Medtronic
profile.summary: Over seven years of experience in software development, deployment, and architecture.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead design and development effort for next generation navigation & robotics platform operating system, connectivity, and web-based applications
- Lead the development and improvement of navigation medical device operating system, service utilities, and configuration tools
- Build Medtronic's global Connected Medical Device (IoT) program since its inception
- Innovate service & repair apps to improve product serviceability

positions.description:

- Lead the development and improvement of navigation medical device operating system, service utilities, and configuration tools

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Lead design and development effort for next generation navigation & robotics platform operating system, connectivity, and web-based applications
- Lead the development and improvement of navigation medical device operating system, service utilities, and configuration tools
- Build Medtronic's global Connected Medical Device (IoT) program since its inception
- Innovate service & repair apps to improve product serviceability

positions.title: Technical Services Specialist
positions.description:
- Handled over 4000 intra-operative or patient care related software, electrical, and hardware issues
- Managed Medtronic technology for almost 50 neuro, spine, & ENT surgeries & two conferences
- Worked with service organizations from all over the world to improve system uptime and resolve customer hardware & software issues
- Performed system admin role for legacy IoT platform
- Improved cross-functional software complaint handling

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
-- Design and construct the necessary hardware and control systems to conduct fluid experiments
-- Conduct cardiovascular fluid mechanics experiments on mechanical heart valves
-- Analyze and describe flow patterns through bileaflet mechanical heart valves

positions.title: EMC Quality & Test Engineering Internship
positions.description:
-- Create test protocol for electromagnetic compliance testing
-- Assist in designing layout for testing of handheld surgical equipment and generators
-- Construct test fixtures for electrosurgical generator testing
-- Package and trouble shoot software stress tester for electrosurgical generators
-- Assist in system validation for electromagnetic compliance test system

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-- Design and prototype artificial heart valves for testing and optimization
-- Construct heart valve fatigue and testing equipment
-- Research current heart valve technology and learn to construct current valves for property analysis

positions.title: Deburr and Assembly
positions.description:
--Operated horizontal CNC milling machine to produce parts to customer specifications
--Deburred and assembled parts for final inspection and shipment
--Organized company filing system and manufacturing floor in order to increase manufacturing efficiency and production
--Assist with parts/materials expediting

positions.title: Patient Transporter
positions.description:
--Patient Transporter required to understand proper procedures for handling contact and airborne contagious specimen and patients
--Delivered patients, blood, specimen, and equipment throughout hospital
--Provided excellent patient care and customer service to over 3,500 patients
--Mastered most direct routes for quickly transporting patients through 100,000 square foot hospital

company.name: The University of Arizona Health Network

projects.title: Medtronic Global IoT Initiative
projects.description:
-Founding contributor for Medtronic's global Connected Medical Devices (IoT) program
-Sole owner, requirements manager, and developer of PyQt UI client-side software, implemented to address marketing and customer feedback
-Worked with cross-business team to develop standard edge software for Linux & Windows-based medical devices for scalability across 13 Medtronic business units

projects.title: Custom Linux-based OS Release Strategy
projects.description:
-Worked with cross-functional team to develop patching strategy for custom Ubuntu operating system
-Lead development of four OS maintenance releases to support implementation of new clinical features & regular security updates (included integration with new 3rd party hardware)
-With software team, ported existing operating system customizations  from Ubuntu 14.04 to Ubuntu 18.04
